findings.detail: After all responses froze, changing every scorer intake to permit responder self-scoring and rebinding the score sheets still produced support-isolated-semantic-recovery-pilot in rev0383.
The responder-bound assignment commitment now fixes exact assignment-plan and scoring-policy bytes before any response.
Assignment, policy, scorer projections, and committed tool hashes must verify after the all-response lock and before custody or scoring.
The final aggregator directly rejects responder self-scoring and self-custody independently of mutable scorer booleans.
Builder, verifier, scorer, package checker, and preflight share one exact policy/runtime field split.
The shared strict parser now rejects finite JSON spellings such as 1e999 when Python would otherwise convert them to infinity.
The final external scorer now delegates artifact parsing to strict_json_bytes rather than maintaining a second parser.
No real four-responder isolated batch or conventional clean OQ-0266 triplet has been imported.

non_claim: Internal reproduced defect and synthetic regression evidence only; not a clean external OQ-0266 result, trusted timestamp, identity proof, causal burden result, or canonical promotion.
